tagline: Your AI-powered assistant for smarter, more efficient farming.
ask_ai_desc: Get expert advice from our AI.
my_expenses_desc: Track farm expenses with your voice.
crop_recommender_desc_short: Get crop suggestions for your land.
voice_command_desc: Tap here to log expenses, ask questions, or get crop advice using your voice.
voice_command_example: Try: "टमाटर का आज का भाव क्या है?"
all_tools_desc: Explore all available features to manage your farm.
daily_advisory_content: Weather is clear. Good day for irrigation of standing crops. Check for pests in the afternoon.
login_description: Enter your phone number to get started.
assistant_unsupported: Speech recognition is not supported in your browser.
pest_alert_description: See and report pest sightings in your community.
report_pest_help: Help your neighbors by reporting pest activity. Fill out the details below.
description_placeholder_pest: Describe what you saw, location, etc.
crop_recommender_desc: Get suggestions for the best crops to plant.
soil_type_question: What is the primary soil type of your farm?
land_size_question: What is the size of your land in acres?
region_question: Which region is your farm located in?
disease_detection_desc: Capture or upload a photo of a plant leaf to diagnose diseases.
camera_denied: Camera not available or permission denied.
fertilizer_calculator_desc: Calculate the required fertilizer for your crops.
market_analysis_desc: Price per Quintal (Qtl) over the last 10 days.
sell_reason: Prices are currently high and have shown strong upward momentum over the past week. It's a good time to lock in profits.
hold_reason: Prices have been stagnant or declining. It might be better to wait for a potential market recovery before selling.
schemes_desc: Find and learn about beneficial government schemes for farmers.
no_schemes_found: No schemes found matching your search.
voice_ledger_desc: Press the microphone to log expenses. Try: "Bought fertilizer for 500 rupees".
log_expense_browser_unsupported: Your browser does not support speech recognition. Please use a different browser like Chrome or Safari.
logging_failed_speak: Sorry, I couldn't log that. Please try again.
profit_prediction_desc: Estimate your potential profit for the season based on your expenses.
based_on_inputs: Based on your inputs and logged expenses.
